Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that's all from this game. West Indies have taken an unassailable 1-0 lead in the series and will now look to seal the series 2-0. On the other hand, South Africa will be disappointed with their effort with the bat in this game and will look to bounce back and by doing so, level the series. The third and final ODI of this series will be played at Senwes Park in Potchefstroom on 21st of March, Tuesday. The first ball will be bowled at 1.30 pm IST (8.00 am GMT). As always you can join us early for the build-up. As always, you can join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, take care and goodbye!

Shai Hope, the captain of West Indies is also the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his brilliance with the bat. Hope says that Temba Bavuma played a great inning but catches win matches and they were able to get over the line. Mentions that it was a difficult pitch to start on with the bat but as soon as you get in, one has to think about going big. Says that it is about playing the situation well and that was what he was able to do and applauds others who contributed with the ball. Says that Akeal Hosein is doing what he does best and it was good to see Alzarri Joseph come back the way he did.

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa, says that Lungi Ngidi held his end well and the approach was to take the game as close as they could. Feels that their death bowling has not been clinical and he would have loved to restrict West Indies to 300 considering the wickets they got up front. Shares that they have a young and inexperienced side and hopes that the boys can take a lot of learnings from such games. Hopes that the learnings can help them to act and think better. Mentions that the chat between him and Ngidi was that if they manage to get two 15-run overs then West Indies would panic. Ends by informing that Nortje is certainly not coming back for the third ODI but Klaasen and Miller are in contention for the game at Potchefstroom.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Shai Hope won the toss and opted to bat first on a dry surface. It was a first start by Kyle Mayers and Brandon King up top for West Indies but they lost three wickets in quick succession. It was then a partnership between skipper Shai Hope with Nicholas Pooran and then again with Rovman Powell that really took the Windies' score above the 300-run mark. Hope finished with a stellar century and West Indies put on a big total of 335 runs on the board. For South Africa, debutant Gerald Coetzee impressed with the ball and picked up three wickets with the two spinners, Bjorn Fortuin and Tabraiz Shamsi picking up a couple of wickets each but almost every bowler went for a bit of a tap. Coming to the chase, the hosts had the start they need but it all started to fall apart in the middle overs with only their skipper, Temba Bavuma holding fort. In the end, his efforts went in vain.

South Africa should be and certainly will be a lot disappointed with that effort. After an under-par display with the ball, their openers Temba Bavuma and Quinton de Kock got them off to just the start they needed. The pair put on 76 runs inside 9 overs before de Kock get out. Bavuma kept on going and with a few handy knocks from the others, the Proteas were in a strong position at 200/4. However, once Tristan Stubbs fell, that triggered a bit of a collapse. With 8 wickets down for 238, it looked impossible to get the win but skipper Bavuma started lacing the ball and got the required margin under 50 runs. He fell on 287 with his score on 144 and with that all hopes of a stellar come back was lost.

West Indies have really pulled one out of the bag here because at one point it looked like South Africa were cruising through the chase but a few soft dismissals and some tidy bowling helped the visitors to get the win. Akeal Hosein was certainly the pick of the bowlers as he picked up three crucial wickets and was economical as well. The likes of Jason Holder and Alzarri Joseph went for a bit of stick early on but Joseph came back in to clean up the tail and ended with three wickets as well. On the whole, they were able to pick up wickets when it mattered and that negated the poor start with the ball and a big score on the board meant that the Windies won the toss.

What a game this has turned out to be! West Indies have managed to topple the Proteas in their own backyard and have done so in style. It got a bit close toward the end but Alzarri Joseph went bang-bang to finish proceedings. The Windies take a 1-0 lead in the series and with just one more game remaining, they cannot lose the series.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Alzarri Joseph wraps things up with two wickets in an over! Serves it on a fuller length and outside off, Tabraiz Shamsi is tempted by the width and goes for the drive away from his body. Gets an outside edge that travels behind the wicket to Shai Hope who pouches it safely. West Indies win by 48 runs and take a 1-0 lead in the series.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off, Tabraiz Shamsi sways away and lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Tabraiz Shamsi is the last man in for South Africa.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Temba Bavuma departs and with him goes the hopes of South Africa! Slower and into the wicket on leg by Alzarri Joseph, Temba Bavuma swivels in his crease and goes for the pull. Gets deceived by the slowness and ends up playing his shot early. The ball catches him on the gloves and lobs behind the wicket to Shai Hope who makes no mistake. Alzarri Joseph has his second wicket of the game and West Indies are now a wicket away from victory.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: Shortish delivery on off by Alzarri Joseph, Lungi Ngidi chops it down to third man for a single.
Slower and back of a length on off, Lungi Ngidi hangs back to defend and gets squared up a bit. The ball comes off the outer part of the bat to short third man for a run.
Back of a length and outside off, Lungi Ngidi goes for a poke away from his body and misses.
Length delivery on off, Lungi Ngidi looks to drive it on the up but finds extra cover.
Good-length delivery on off, Temba Bavuma taps it to point and takes one.
Back of a length and angling in on leg, Lungi Ngidi tucks it off his hips to deep square leg for a single.
Starts on a good length around off, Temba Bavuma makes room and punches it to deep cover for a single.
Powerplay 3! The fielding side now has the luxury of having as many as five fielders outside the inner ring until the end of the 50 overs.
Full and honing in at the stumps, Lungi Ngidi presents a straight bat and drives it to mid off.
Bowls it full and just outside off, Lungi Ngidi looks to go down the ground without much foot movement and connects with thin air.
Banged in short and at the batter, Lungi Ngidi ducks under it quickly and lets the ball go.
Low full toss on leg, Temba Bavuma gets deceived by the slowness of the delivery but still manages to clip it to mid-wicket for a single.
Nails the yorker at the stumps, Temba Bavuma squeezes this one towards the backward square leg region where Shamarh Brooks slides to his right and keeps it to two.
Back of a length on off, Lungi Ngidi stays back and taps it wide of backward point for a single.
Short and quicker outside off, Temba Bavuma goes on the back foot to punch this one but misses.
Short and around off, Temba Bavuma goes to work it on the off side but does not connect.
SIX! Yannic Cariah floats it, full outside off, Temba Bavuma gest down and sweeps it flat and wide of deep square leg for the third maximum of the over.
Short and flatter around off, Temba Bavuma hangs back to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.

SIX! Back-to-back sixes for Temba Bavuma! Shortens his length and bowls it on middle, Temba Bavuma picks the length early and rocks back in his crease. Pulls it towards the mid-wicket fence for yet another maximum.
SIX! Temba Bavuma greets Yannic Cariah with a maximum! Starts with a flighted delivery on leg, Temba Bavuma clears his front leg and thumps it towards the long on fence for a maximum.
Another bumper aimed at the batter, Lungi Ngidi ducks and lets the ball pass. A tidy over by Alzarri Joseph.
Sharp bouncer! Bends his back and bangs it on middle, Lungi Ngidi ducks under it and lets it go through to the keeper.
Bowls it full and outside off, Lungi Ngidi drives it along the ground to mid off for a dot.
Slower and on a good length on middle, Temba Bavuma waits for it and nudges it gently towards deep square leg for a single.
Fullish delivery on off, Temba Bavuma makes room but can only dig this one out back to the bowler.
Short of a length on middle by Alzarri Joseph, Temba Bavuma hops on the back foot and keeps it out on the off side.
Slower and full outside off, Lungi Ngidi tries to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge by the away turn.
Angles it in full and on off, Lungi Ngidi gets on the front foot and defends it on the off side.
SIX! SHOT! Bowls it full and on off, right in the slot for the batter, Lungi Ngidi does not miss out as he slog sweeps it well over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Short and quicker on off, Lungi Ngidi punches it to extra cover where Brandon King dives quickly to his left and prevents the single.
Short and around off, Temba Bavuma goes back and cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Short and turning away outside off, Temba Bavuma stays leg side of the ball and goes for the cut. Plays the shot a bit early and gets an inside edge that rolls past the off stump.
Full and outside off, Lungi Ngidi frees his arms to go through the off side but gets it from the toe end of the bat to mid off for a dot.
Good-length delivery on leg, Temba Bavuma nudges it to deep square leg and takes one .
Banged in short around off, Temba Bavuma rides on top of the bounce and pulls it wide of long on for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Sprays it on a length but down the leg side, Temba Bavuma leaves the ball alone and the umpire signals a wide.
SIX! Short and punsihed! Slower and into the wicket on middle, Temba Bavuma picks the length early and latches onto the pull shot. Hits it flat and towards the square leg fence for a maximum.
Back of a length on middle, Lungi Ngidi taps it towards cover where Brandon King fumbles and allows the batters to run a single.
Fullish delivery on leg, Temba Bavuma digs this one out to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Tossed up, full on middle by Akeal Hosein, Lungi Ngidi watchfully keeps it out on the off side.
Short and quicker around off, Lungi Ngidi goes for the cut but misses.
Short and flatter on middle, Lungi Ngidi works it off the back foot to mid-wicket.

DROPPED! Rovman Powell has shelled it! Flighted, full on middle, Temba Bavuma gets down and goes for the sweep. The ball catches the leading edge of his bat and travels all the way to deep mid-wicket. Rovman Powell stationed there runs to his right and goes for the catch with hard hands. The ball bounces out of his hands and the batters cross for a single. Akeal Hosein isn't pleased with this drop.
Full and on middle, Lungi Ngidi gets forward to defend but gets it from the outer part of the bat. The ball rolls wide of short third man which allows the batters to cross for a single.
Darted in at the stumps, Lungi Ngidi gets behind the line and defends it to cover.
Lungi Ngidi comes in at number 10.

OUT! RUN OUT! Another one bites the dust and that's the last thing South Africa needed at the moment. On a good length over middle, Temba Bavuma works it away toward the gap at mid-wicket and looks for two right away. The batters push hard for it but it is Akeal Hosein from backward square leg who gets to it and throws it at the bowler's end. Odean Smith comes racing in toward the ball and manages to dislodge the bails. It is sent upstairs to be checked and the replays show that Gerald Coetzee is short of his crease.
Good length around middle, this is worked away in front of mid-wicket for a single.
A touch fuller around off, this is nudged toward short third man.
On a good length around off, kept out by Gerald Coetzee.
Back of a length over off stump, Temba Bavuma looks to pull but gets an inside edge into the thigh pad. The ball rolls on the off side and they get a single.
FOUR! Temba Bavuma doing all he can here! Banged in short and over off stump, Bavuma pulls this one in front of square on the leg side and finds the fence.
Gerald Coetzee walks out to the middle. Can he support his skipper?

OUT! STUMPED! Akeal Hosein with a lovely piece of bowling and he gets a second wicket in the over. Hosein flaights this one up on a nagging length around off, drawing the batter forward. Bjorn Fortuin takes the bait and leans forward trying to make the block. The ball just grips and turns away a touch beating the outside edge. Shai Hope whips the bails off in a flash and seems confident. The third umpire is called in and there's nothing on UltraEdge. A few replays are checked and it is confirmed that Fortuin's foot is on the line and no part of it is behind the line. The decision of Out comes on the screen.
Commentary.Howout: st Shai Hope b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller one o off stump, Temba Bavuma looks for the hard sweep but gets it off the inner half of the blade toward backward square leg. The batters scamper through for one as Odean Smith there misfields.
Shorter in length and outside off, tapped away to deep cover for one.
Bjorn Fortuin is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! What have you done, Marco Jansen? That is a soft dismissal and West Indies are gifted a wicket here. Akeal Hosein tosses this one up around middle and off, Jansen skips down the track and looks to loft it over long on but in the end, just checks his shot as he doesn't quite reach the pitch of the ball. Jansen ends up lofting it flat and down the throat of Rovman Powell at long on and he makes no mistake. South Africa now need 107 runs with 4 wickets in hand!
Commentary.Howout: c Rovman Powell b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Full and around off, this is pushed away to mid off.
Shorter one outside off and turning away, Marco Jansen stands tall and slaps it away well wide of the man at long off for a couple of runs.
Hard length around middle, this is tucked away through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Muscled away! Short of a length over middle and Jansen simply pulls it away into the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
A bumper now, over off and middle, Marco Jansen looks to take it on but is well beaten.
Back of a length around off, Marco Jansen eases it toward the point region.
Length ball on off stump, Jansen plays it on the up toward cover.
Good length around the top of off, Temba Bavuma stays back and nudges it down to third man for a single.
A bit flatter and around off stump, Jansen defends it out.
Floated up a bit around middle, Marco Jansen comes down the pitch and lifts it right back over the bowler's head in between long off and long on for a couple of runs.
This is bowled on middle, Jansen keeps it out.

FOUR! Cheeky attempt and Marco Jansen rakes up yet another fruitful boundary. Fuller on the stumps, Jansen goes for the reverse sweep and gets a bottom edge in between the keeper and first slip for a boundary down to third man.
Slowed up, on a shorter length and around off, Marco Jansen defends it out.

There it is, Temba Bavuma brings up three figures and he is in supreme form at the moment. Flatter delivery around off, pushed away through the cover region for a single and a HUNDRED to savor for the Proteas skipper. He takes off the helmet and soaks in the applause from the crowd but he will know he needs to stay on till the end.

FOUR! Edged away! Bowls it on a hard length outside off, Marco Jansen pushes at it with hard hands and off the back foot but gets a thick outside edge. The ball runs down to the vacant third man fence for a boundary.
Marco Jansen comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another one bites the dust and South Africa are digging themselves into deep trouble! Odean Smith continues to bowl short and outside off but takes pace off the ball. Tristan Stubbs is early into the pull shot and the ball hits the toe-end of the bat. It flies high into the air behind the batter where Shai Hope settles under this. It is a straightforward catch especially with the gloves on and South Africa now find half their side back in the shed. West Indies will believe they are close to the finish line provided they get across Temba Bavuma!
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Odean Smith

Back of a length and outside off. Temba Bavuma slaps this towards deep cover for another single.

Comes over the wicket and bowls this full, outside off. Temba Bavuma paddles this to the right of short fine leg for a run.

Bowls this one slightly short and in line with the stumps. Tristan Stubbs dabs this back to the bowler's right.
Tosses this one wider outside off on a fuller length. Tristan Stubbs reaches for it and gets beaten.
Akeal Hosein floats this one full and outside off. Temba Bavuma pushes this towards deep point for one.

Alzarri Joseph goes full and in line with the stumps. Tristan Stubbs flicks this towards mid-wicket.

Drinks break! South Africa are now suddenly four wickets down but Temba Bavuma is standing strong at one end. With 136 runs more needed for victory and 6 wickets in hand, South Africa still have a firm grip on the game. On the other hand, West Indies have bowled well in the past few overs but they need to chip in with wickets at regular intervals to remain in the game.

OUT! CAUGHT! GREAT BOUNCER! Alzarri Joseph continues to take important wickets for West Indies! This is banged in short and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen is rushed into the shot and looks to pull this away. He gets a top edge that floats towards the man at deep backward square leg. Shamarh Brooks makes no mistake holding onto the ball and South Africa are now four wickets down with 200 on the board.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Alzarri Joseph

Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside off. Temba Bavuma punches this off his back foot towards deep cover for a run.
Bowls this on a yorker length and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen digs this out towards point and a misfield allows them to take a single.
On a good length and wide outside off. Temba Bavuma dabs this down to third man for a run.

Strays onto the pads on a good length. Tony de Zorzi clips this towards deep backward square leg for one.
Bowls this back of a length and wide outside off. Temba Bavuma slaps this towards deep point for a single.

Odean Smith bowls this back of a length and into the batter. Temba Bavuma looks to play this leg side but misses and gets hit on the body.

Googly, full outside off, Tony de Zorzi drives it to deep cover for a single.
Flatter at the stumps, Temba Bavuma gets down and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, full outside off, Temba Bavuma gets forward and blocks it to point.

OUT! LBW! Yannic Cariah comes on and strikes straightaway! Starts with a flighted delivery, full on middle, Ryan Rickelton presses forward and looks to defend with a straight bat. He plays down the wrong line and gets trapped in front of the stumps. West Indies go up in appeal and the umpire raises the finger.  Ryan Rickelton has a word with Temba Bavuma and goes for a review. The UltraEdge shows no bat and it is hitting the wickets on Ball Tracking. The on-field decision stands and Ryan Rickelton has to depart.

Drinks break! This has been a rollicking start by South Africa in their pursuit of 336. With his free-flowing strokeplay, skipper Temba Bavuma has ensured that his side is keeping up with the required run rate. On the other hand, West Indies have been all over the place with their lines and lengths in these first 16 overs. They need to reassess during this break and find a way to stem the flow of runs or else the game will slip out of their hands in a matter of few overs. They now bring Yannic Cariah into the attack.
Too full and on middle, defended back to the bowler.
FOUR! Quality shot! Loopy and full, landing around off and turning away, Temba Bavuma goes down and muscles his slog sweep over mid-wicket.
Flatter and on middle, Ryan gets back and eases it past the bowler to long on for a run.
Full and flighted, around off, Bavuma sweeps it firmly to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, Bavuma defends it from the back foot.
Flighted on off, knocked down to long on for a run.

Howzzatt? Not given. Shai Hope reviews. Kyle Mayers serves it on a fuller length, around middle and leg, Temba Bavuma fails to flick and is pinged on the front pad. The appeal for an lbw is not entertained. DRS time. Nothing on the UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows that it's missing the leg stump. West Indies lose a review.
FOUR! Sublime! Short in length around off, at a gentle pace, Temba Bavuma rides the bounce and pulls it behind square leg for a boundary.
On a length outside off, Bavuma pushes inside the line and misses.
SIX! Handsome shot to bring up his fifty, off 48 balls. Fuller in length and around off, Bavuma leans into the shot and lofts it inside-out over extra cover for a biggie.
Wide! Short and down the leg side, Bavuma tries to cash in with a pull shot but misses.
Slower one, around off and cutting back in, TB defends it off the inner edge. It falls on his right boot.
Appeal for an lbw! Full and around middle, angling down, Bavuma fails to flick. He is struck on the pads but it's sliding down.
Eases a full ball to the left of cover-point for a single.
Turning away a shade from around off, Bavuma defends it from the outer portion of his bat.
Good bite from the surface. Drifting in around off and spinning away, Bavuma tries to defend inside the line and gets beaten.
Uses the spin and works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
In the line of the stumps, pushed back.

SIX! A good effort in the deep by Nicholas Pooran but he ends up conceding a biggie. Tossed up around middle, Ryan Rickelton powers it over square leg and Nicholas Pooran takes the catch with a jump. In the process, he stepped on the fence. 100 up!
Pitches it up and around off, Ryan plays in the V and knocks it down to long on for one.
Slower cutter, on a length around off, Ryan tries to play through the line but it takes the inner edge and goes to short mid-wicket.
On a length around off, it's driven to deep cover for one.

FOUR! Shot! Too full in length and outside off, Temba Bavuma steps down a bit and hammers it off the lower end of his bat. It whistles past the umpire at the other end and reaches the fence in a flash.
Edgy! This one cuts back into the batter from a good length around off, Ryan Rickelton flicks it off the inner edge to square leg. They cross.
Back of a length around off, coming slowly off the surface, Ryan waits and then turns it towards mid-wicket.
Drags his length short, around off, Ryan goes back and works it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Slower and fuller, around off, Temba gently nudges it to cover-point and steals a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short in length and down the leg side, Temba Bavuma swivels on the back foot and places his pull shot behind square leg for a boundary.
Slightly short and outside off, Bavuma plays it down to cover-point and crosses for a run. The fielder makes a diving stop but his throw at the keeper's end is wayward. They cross for one more.
Floated and full, around off and turning in, Ryan Rickelton tries to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects behind the keeper and they cross.
Flatter and on off, forced through covers for a single.
Slower one, on a good length around off, Temba plays late and guides it down to third man for a run.
Fuller and outside off, driven down the ground but straight to mid off.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it defensively to the off side.
That didn't miss the off stump by much. Quicker and just outside off, a yorker, Bavuma fails to keep it out.
Fuller and on off, it's dragged wide of mid on for a single.
Angles in a length ball on off, Ryan offers a straight bat and pushes it to mid on.
Time for Powerplay 2! West Indies can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the 30-yard circle until the 40th over.
Extra bounce, from a length around off, Bavuma tries to defend but misses and is hit high on the pads. Powerplay 1 is over and South Africa are off to a strong start despite losing Quinton de Kock.
A touch full and around off, Temba stays back and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
On middle, Bavuma uses the angle but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
On a good length, around off, Temba defends it from the back foot to point.
A bit short and slow, around off, Bavuma wrists it gently in front of square leg and they steal a couple of runs. Excellent running between the wickets.
Slightly short and outside off, Bavuma walks closer to the line of the delivery and taps it down to point.
Full and angling down the leg side, Ryan tries working it around but misses. He is rapped on the thigh pad but only a mild appeal follows.
In the channel outside off, Ryan Rickelton lets it through to the keeper.
Ryan Rickelton walks in at number 3.

OUT! Given lbw! Quinton de Kock has decided to review it. Kyle Mayers sprints from 'round the wicket and hurls across a length ball around off. The angle takes it into the left-hander, beats his defensive bat and strikes him on the back leg. Mayers is the only one appealing and the finger goes up. DRS time. The UltraEdge finds nothing and the Ball Tracking shows that it's clipping the top of the leg stump. A sparkling knock from de Kock is over. 260 needed off 248 balls.
Full and outside off, Temba walks forward and eases his drive to deep cover for a run.
FOUR! A flurry of boundaries. Length delivery in the zone outside off, Temba Bavuma reaches out and crunches it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over backward point. Width there outside off, Bavuma throws his hands at it and the ball flies just over the fielder inside the ring for a boundary.

Shout for an lbw! Not given. Full and around leg, Quinton de Kock tries to flick but misses. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal but the finger stays down. Holder convinces his skipper to take the DRS. Pitching outside leg.
On the pads, helped behind square leg for a run.
FOUR! Put away! Short in length and on off, Bavuma hangs back and pulls it with power through square leg for a boundary.
Gently taps it down in the gap at covers and sneaks a quick run.
FOUR! Edgy again and this time it has gone to the boundary. Holder digs it in short, around off, Quinton top-edges his attempted pull shot and it flies behind the keeper.
Edgy. Angling away outside off, de Kock has a loose drive at it and edges it towards short third man. It goes on one bounce to the fielder.
Full and on the pads, eased to deep square leg for a run.
Stays on the back foot and punches it to deep cover for one.
Back to over the wicket. On a length and outside off, Bavuma pushes at it and misses.
Too straight in line and Quinton works it towards square leg for one.
Full and angling in, around off, from 'round the wicket, de Kock forces it down to mid on.
FOUR! Put away! Back of a length, around off and angling in, Quinton stays tall and powers it behind square leg for a boundary. In full control.
Short and outside off, played down to point for a single.
In the channel outside off, there is width and Temba runs it down to third man for a single.
Straighter in line, Bavuma stays back and defends it on the leg side.
Angling in around off, on a length, Temba defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Beaten! Lovely shape there for Jason. Serves it outside off, on a length and nipping away, Bavuma has a loose waft at it and misses.
Delivers it on a length, around off and some extra bounce, Bavuma tries to defend but misses and is hit high on the pads.
SIX! Cracking shot! Alzarri Joseph bowls it back of a length outside off, Quinton de Kock sets up himself nice and early. Smokes the pull shot well over the square leg fence for a maximum.
Lands it on a good length around off, Temba Bavuma steers it down to third man and collects another single.
Full and on off, Quinton de Kock clips it to the left of mid on and takes a single.
FOUR! Fuller and outside off, Quinton de Kock gets into a good positon and creams the drive through cover for a boundary.

SIX! Another pickup shot by Quinton de Kock fetches him a maximum! Angling in on a length on middle by Alzarri Joseph, Quinton de Kock stays in the crease and whips this one over fine leg fence for a maximum.
Bowls it on a good length in the channel outside off, Temba Bavuma guides it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Jason Holder tries to go full but ends up bowling a low full toss outside off, Quinton de Kock does not miss out as he drives it through covers for yet another boundary.
Angling across on a length outside off, Quinton de Kock blocks this one out on the leg side.
Another delivery on a good length, Temba Bavuma opens the bat face and runs it down to third man for a single.
Lands it on a good length on off, Temba Bavuma dabs this one to backward point for a dot.
SIX! Temba Bavuma gets into the act now! Short and around off by Jason Holder, Temba Bavuma gets underneath the delivery nicely and pulls it well over the square leg fence for a maximum.
Back of a length and angling in on leg, Quinton de Kock tucks this one to deep backward square leg for a run.
Keeps it short and outside off, Quinton de Kock stays back and punches it to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Short and outside off by Alzarri Joseph, Quinton de Kock gets the width he needs and lets his hands flow. Cuts it through point for a boundary.
SIX! Put away by Quinton de Kock! Length delivery angling across on off, Quinton de Kock picks the length early and whips it over Odean Smith at deep square leg for his first maximum.
Short of a length and outside off, Temba Bavuma rides on top of the bounce and guides it to the left of backward point for a single.
Fullish delivery tailing in on off, Temba Bavuma squeezes this one out to backward point.
Short and shaping in on middle, Quinton de Kock cuts it off the back foot to deep point for a run.
Another delivery on a good length around off, Temba Bavuma stays on the back foot and taps it to backward point. A probing first over by Jason Holder.
Goes wide of the crease and serves it on a good length outside off, a hint of away movement, Temba Bavuma pokes at this delivery but luckily for him, he does not edge this one.
Bowls it fuller and outside off, Temba Bavuma presses forward and drives it to mid off for a dot.
Length delivery outside off, Temba Bavuma tries to go through the off side but without much foot movement. Gets it from the toe end of the bat to mid on.
Short and outside off, Temba Bavuma gets on his toes to cut this one but mishits it to extra cover.
Starts on a good length in the channel outside off, Temba Bavuma stays back and dabs it to backward point for a dot.
It will be Jason Holder to operate from the other end.
Length delivery outside off, Quinton de Kock gets the width he needs and drives it wide of mid off for a brace.
On a good length and around off, Quinton de Kock taps it to cover and sets off for a single but gets sent back by Temba Bavuma.
Back of a length on middle by Alzarri Joseph, Quinton de Kock hangs back and keeps it out towards mid-wicket.
Full and seaming in on middle, Temba Bavuma drives it wide of mid on and opens his account with a single.
Leg bye! Back of a length again and at the pads, Quinton de Kock misses the clip and gets hit on the thigh. The ball rolls to fine leg for a single.
Starts with a back-of-a-length delivery on middle and leg, Quinton de Kock gets hurried as he tried to work it on the leg side. Wears it on the thigh and the ball rolls towards first slip.
